2) Procurement team validates SOC2 and DPA; we attach to the account profile.

Hi Maya / DataForge team — looping in Finance and Onboarding to confirm next steps. Quick items from Redwood side:

1) Approval chain: Standard delegated approvals cover term extensions up to 24 months and capacity changes up to 50% without exec sign-off. Because this is an 18-month term with a staged top-up that sums to a ~45% capacity increase over baseline, we can process with delegated approvals. No additional Revenue Ops sign-off required.

2) PO ingestion: we can accept the DataForge_PO_Template.xlsx uploaded to our procurement portal. Please indicate the PO number in the subject line when you upload.

3) Billing and invoicing: Redwood prefers net-30, monthly invoicing. If DataForge needs quarterly invoices, we can accommodate but will need to note that in the PO. Billing contact fields we need: billing_name, billing_email, VAT (if applicable).

4) Evidence: SOC2_Attestation_2025.pdf is sufficient for procurement intake. If we need a pen-test or customer-specific questionnaire later, we'll surface that during onboarding — not gating the PO.

5) Ramp plan: Jonas will own the onboarding schedule. Target: start phased increase 30 days after PO effective date (Q1 top-up), second bump at +6 months.

Action items for DataForge:
- Upload signed PO (template attached) with PO number in the subject
- Confirm billing contact + invoice cadence
- Indicate preferred start date for the phased ramp (we'll schedule ops accordingly)

I'll assign a ticket in our onboarding queue once we see the PO.

Thanks,
